name: thinwindow
description: Less in the window. Less on the bill. Most of your agent's tokens are re-reads: 87–96% is context re-sent every turn. ThinWindow is both a Claude Code plugin and an Agent Skill, and it shrinks that context: 12–23% fewer tokens, measured in Claude Code on three models.
author: Iván Luna (https://github.com/imprvhub)
